# Amazon Eco Travellers

> Expert naturalist-guided Amazon eco tours departing from Manaus, Brazil.

Amazon Eco Travellers offers immersive multi-day expeditions and day excursions into the Brazilian Amazon rainforest. All tours depart from Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil. Guides are specialist naturalists — not biologists — with deep knowledge of Amazonian ecosystems, wildlife, and indigenous culture.

## Multi-day expeditions

- [Amazon Explorers](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/amazon-explorers/): 5 days / 4 nights. Rio Negro basin, canopy tower, flooded igapó forest, pink river dolphin habitat, eco-lodge + riverboat.
- [River Explorer](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/river-explorer/): 5 days / 4 nights. Rio Negro upriver, MUSA canopy tower, Anavilhanas National Park, indigenous village visit.
- [Chlorophyll](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/chlorophyll/): 6 days / 5 nights. Five ecosystems: canopy, igapó, terra firme, várzea, riverine community.
- [Birdwatching](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/birdwatching/): 7 days / 6 nights. Ornithologist-guided, 600+ potential species, Cock-of-the-Rock arena, Anavilhanas floodplain.
- [Ecological Expedition](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/ecological-expedition/): 8 days / 7 nights. Most comprehensive route. Ducke Reserve canopy to Madeira River.
- [Jungle Lodge Expedition](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/jungle-lodge-3days/): 3 days / 2 nights. Meeting of the Waters, riverside lodge, piranha fishing, caiman search, jungle walk. From R$1,500/person.
- [Amazon Lodge](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/amazon-lodge/): 2 days / 1 night. Overnight lodge stay, pink river dolphin habitat, piranha fishing, caiman search. From R$1,000/person.
- [Jungle Retreat](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/jungle-retreat/): 4 days / 3 nights. Manaus historic market, Meeting of the Waters, lodge + jungle camp, caboclo community. From R$2,000/person.
- [The Full Amazon](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/amazon-complete/): 5 days / 4 nights. Most culturally complete: pink river dolphin habitat, indigenous overnight stay, optional Ayahuasca ceremony. From R$5,000/person.
- [Amazon Expedition](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/amazon-expedition/): 6 days / 5 nights. Lodge + remote tapiri camp at Lago do Arara, survival techniques, deep forest walks. From R$4,200/person.

## Day excursions

- [Pink Dolphins & Indigenous Village](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/pink-dolphins/): 1 day from Manaus.
- [Ariau River & Rio Negro](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/ariau-river/): 1 day from Manaus.
- [Pink Dolphins & Anavilhanas](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/anavilhanas/): 1 day from Manaus to the Anavilhanas River Archipelago. R$1,100/person.
- [Presidente Figueiredo](https://amazonecotravellers.com/tours/presidente-figueiredo/): 1 day, waterfalls & caves. R$800/person.

## Blog

Field notes and travel guides written by the Amazon Eco Travellers team in Manaus.

- [Amazon Rainforest Tours from Manaus: What to Expect](https://amazonecotravellers.com/blog/amazon-tours-from-manaus/): first-hand guide to what happens on a tour, how many days you need, best season, and realistic wildlife expectations.
- [Best Time to Visit the Amazon: A Month-by-Month Guide](https://amazonecotravellers.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-amazon/): high-water vs low-water season and month-by-month planning.
